subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling with Starlit AI
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Jill Tan <jill@starlit.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling with Starlit AI

Hi Jill —

Thanks again for the strong partnership this year. As we discussed in our last exec touch point, Starlit is coming up on renewal in Q1 and your team has indicated a desire to formalize a capacity uplift across inference and embeddings for the next 12 months. I wanted to kick off a short renewal / expansion plan so we can:

- Align stakeholders (technical, procurement, legal)
- Lock in a mutual action plan and timeline for price/term review
- Schedule a QBR to review usage, headroom, and next-step recommendations

Proposed timeline:
1) Week of Dec 11 — internal Redwood prep and draft MOP for uplift (attached: redwood_mop_draft.pdf)
2) Week of Dec 18 — 30 minute stakeholder sync to agree on target capacity and metrics
3) Early Jan — commercial check with procurement/legal and final quote

Can you confirm who from Starlit should join the stakeholder sync (technical lead + procurement contact)? Also: are there any hard calendar blackout dates for late Dec?

Next steps on our side: Ben will propose 3 QBR slots after internal alignment, and Marissa will circulate the uplift summary workbook for your review. Attached is a starter uplift summary to speed the discussion.

Thanks — aim to keep this lightweight and actionable.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mateo direct: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_mop_draft.pdf (draft mutual action plan), starlit_uplift_summary.xlsx (capacity/usage workbook)
From: Jill Tan <jill@starlit.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: serviceops@starlit.ai
Date: Mon, 04 Dec 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling with Starlit AI

Hi Mateo —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Technical lead: Aaron Chu (aaron@starlit.ai)
- Procurement: contracts@starlit.ai (they own price/term reviews)
- Legal: I will loop them if the final term changes materially.

Blackout: Our execs are off Dec 24–Jan 1, so best to avoid late Dec for decision milestones.

Two asks from our side: can you include a short note about data residency implications if we increase regional capacity? Also procurement will request SOC 2 documentation and retention/audit logs for any Dedicated capacity. If you can attach the SOC evidence or a link, that would speed review.

I can make the stakeholder sync the week of Dec 18 — Aaron and procurement can join a 30–45 min call. Please propose slots.

Thanks,
Jill
Head of Infrastructure | Starlit AI
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jill Tan <jill@starlit.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling with Starlit AI

Hey Jill —

Thanks for the quick reply. Available slots for the week of Dec 18 (PST):
- Tue Dec 19, 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed Dec 20, 1:00–1:45pm PT
- Thu Dec 21, 3:00–3:45pm PT

If none of those work, we can also do a quick 30-min async review: I can record a 10-minute walkthrough of the uplift workbook and MOP and share notes.

On the SOC 2 and residency items: attaching a short-run SOC 2 evidence pack and a private link to our compliance page (see links). For residency, increasing regional capacity would keep customer data in your selected cloud region by default; if you want Dedicated VPC options we should cover that in the stakeholder sync since procurement/legal will need an addendum.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_evidence.pdf
Related link: https://redwood.app/compliance/soc2 (see SOC 2 summary and audit contact)

Action items:
- Mateo: confirm which slot and send calendar invite + agenda
- Jill: confirm Aaron and procurement attendee emails
- Marissa: finalize the uplift workbook with projected Q1 token growth and cost estimates

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Jill Tan <jill@starlit.ai>, Aaron Chu <aaron@starlit.ai>, contracts@starlit.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Dec 2028 14:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff: capacity uplift & QBR scheduling with Starlit AI

Thanks all — locking in Tue Dec 19 at 10:00am PT for the 30–45 min stakeholder sync. I just sent a calendar invite. Agenda in the invite: 1) Capacity targets & short-term headroom, 2) Commercial/term ask, 3) Compliance/residency checklist, 4) Next steps & owners.

Agenda doc and pre-read (short): https://redwood.app/drive/driveid-9a8b7c

Quick run of immediate next steps:
- Aaron: please confirm the technical target (target rps / token budget) in reply so Ben can harden the uplift workbook before the call.
- procurement (contracts@starlit.ai): we'll send an initial redline-ready quote and MSA addendum for Dedicated/Regional options after the sync.
- Marissa: please produce a 1-page cost delta for the three uplift tiers by EOD Monday so procurement has numbers to evaluate.

If anyone needs to switch the slot, flag it here; otherwise we'll proceed and pull in legal post-sync if an addendum is needed.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Best,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
